verdict.text: 1 label blocked by the code (Larger Text); 3 to review, no blocker found for 1

labels.name: VoiceOver
labels.checked: Icon-only buttons without an accessibility label, and labels that name the control type.
labels.manual: Complete every common task with VoiceOver alone: reading order, grouping, values and states, custom actions, focus in modal views.

labels.name: Voice Control
labels.checked: Icon-only buttons without a name Voice Control can show and say.
labels.manual: Say "Show names" and "Show numbers" on every screen of the common tasks; reach swipe and long-press actions by voice; dictate into every text field.

labels.name: Larger Text
labels.checked: Text scaling turned off or capped below 200% (for the whole app or one view), and fixed font sizes that Dynamic Type does not scale.
labels.manual: Use the common tasks at the largest accessibility text size: no overlapping text, no truncation that hides information.

labels.name: Dark Interface
labels.checked: A light appearance forced in Info.plist, the build settings, the Expo config or code; a Flutter app without a dark theme; asset colours without a dark variant.
labels.manual: Use the common tasks in Dark Mode: no screen, sheet, web view or launch screen that flashes bright.

labels.name: Differentiate Without Color Alone
labels.checked: Nothing: whether colour is the only difference is a question of design, not of code a11ylabel can read.
labels.manual: Look for status, charts and selections told apart by colour alone; add a shape, symbol or text.

labels.name: Sufficient Contrast
labels.checked: Asset catalog colours without a high contrast variant for the Increase Contrast setting.
labels.manual: Measure text and controls against their background: about 4.5:1 for most text, by default or with Increase Contrast.

labels.name: Reduced Motion
labels.checked: Repeating, parallax, 3D and auto-playing animations in an app that never reads the Reduce Motion setting, or in files that do not.
labels.manual: Turn on Reduce Motion and use the common tasks: no spinning, scaling, parallax or auto-advancing motion left.

labels.name: Captions
labels.checked: Whether the app plays video, which makes the label apply.
labels.manual: Check that the video and audio of the common tasks have captions or transcripts, and that people can tell which media is captioned.

labels.name: Audio Descriptions
labels.checked: Whether the app plays video, which makes the label apply.
labels.manual: Check that the video of the common tasks offers an audio-described track.

findings.title: Text size locked for the whole app
findings.message: The window's maximumContentSizeCategory is .extraExtraLarge: no text in it grows past that size, below 200%.

fix.title: Remove the content size limit from the window
steps: Remove maximumContentSizeCategory from the window, or set it to .accessibilityExtraLarge (AX3) or larger.
Limit only views that cannot grow and offer the Large Content Viewer for them (UILargeContentViewerInteraction).
Check the common tasks at the largest accessibility size.

sources.title: Larger Text evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)
React 19 upgrade guide: defaultProps removed from function components

findings.title: Text that does not scale
findings.message: adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory is false: this text keeps its size when the system text size changes.

fix.title: Let this label follow Dynamic Type
steps: Give the label a font from UIFont.preferredFont(forTextStyle:) or UIFontMetrics(forTextStyle:).scaledFont(for:), which that property needs to take effect.
Set numberOfLines = 0 so the text wraps.

sources.title: Larger Text evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)

findings.title: Fixed font size
findings.message: systemFont(ofSize:) gives a fixed point size, and this file never scales a font with UIFontMetrics.

fix.title: Scale the font with UIFontMetrics
steps: Wrap the font: UIFontMetrics(forTextStyle: .body).scaledFont(for: font), or use UIFont.preferredFont(forTextStyle:).
Set adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory = true on the label, text field or text view.

sources.title: Larger Text evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)

findings.title: Motion in an app that never reads Reduce Motion
findings.message: UIInterpolatingMotionEffect, a parallax effect, and nothing in the app reads Reduce Motion.

fix.title: Read Reduce Motion and calm the animation
steps: Check UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled before starting the animation, and observe UIAccessibility.reduceMotionStatusDidChangeNotification.
When it is on, skip parallax (UIInterpolatingMotionEffect) and endless animations, or replace them with a cross-fade.

sources.title: Reduced Motion evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)

findings.title: Icon-only button without an accessibility label
findings.message: hideButton gets an image and no title or accessibilityLabel in this file.

fix.title: Name the button
steps: For a system action, prefer UIBarButtonItem(systemItem:), which comes with a localized label.

findings.title: Light by default, dark through an in-app setting
findings.message: Ledger: UIUserInterfaceStyle is Light, but Ledger/SceneDelegate.swift switches to a dark appearance: check that the setting keeps every common task dark.

fix.title: Check the in-app dark mode
steps: Turn on the app's dark setting and use the common tasks: launch, sign-in, purchase and settings must stay dark.
Consider following the system appearance by default, so people who use Dark Mode do not have to find the setting.

sources.title: Dark Interface evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)

findings.title: Accessibility label names the control type
findings.message: The label "Balance tab" ends with "tab", which VoiceOver already says from the element's traits.

fix.title: Drop the control type from the label
steps: Shorten the label to the action ("Close"); set accessibilityTraits = .button on custom controls.

sources.title: VoiceOver evaluation criteria (App Store Connect Help)

findings.title: The app plays video
findings.message: AVPlayerViewController plays video here: check that it has captions and an audio-described track.

fix.title: Check the media, then decide on the two labels
steps: List the videos of the common tasks and check each for a captions track and a described-audio track.
With AVPlayerViewController, the system shows legible and audio options when the asset has them.
